hypothesis: 10-11% of data loads miss the dTLB on c8a. THP=always backs anonymous memory (jemalloc arenas holding the EVM's per-call state maps and caches) with 2 MiB pages instead of madvise-only. MDBX's file-backed mmap is not affected, so expect a small gain at most, mainly on heavy calls.
llm_commentary: THP=always on the champion build (verified [always] on the boxes; build.sh resets it to madvise on the next build) is within noise on x86, c8a 4.67→4.61s (ranges 4.62-4.73 vs 4.56-4.65) and c8i 5.47→5.43s, and a clear 3.9% win on Graviton4, c8g 6.72→6.46s (6.69-6.76 vs 6.41-6.50). THP only backs anonymous memory, so the gain comes from the heap (jemalloc arenas holding the EVM's per-call state maps and caches), not MDBX's file-backed mmap. Graviton4 gains most, consistent with costlier page walks with 4 KiB pages there. Like maxperf and the layout flag, it is a Graviton-only lever on this workload; worth applying per family rather than globally.
